    n_str = str(n)
    for i in range(1, len(n_str)):
        if n_str[i] < n_str[i-1]:
            return False
    return True

def is_decreasing(n):
    n_str = str(n)
    for i in range(1, len(n_str)):
        if n_str[i] > n_str[i-1]:
            return False
    return True

def is_bouncy(n):
    n_str = str(n)
    for i in range(1, len(n_str)):
        if n_str[i] < n_str[i-1]:
            return True
        elif n_str[i] > n_str[i-1]:
            return False
    return False

def total_inc_dec(x):
    count = 0
    for i in range(1, 10**x):
        if is_increasing(i) or is_decreasing(i):
            count += 1
    return count

    # Step 4: Count the words
